source: Gourineni et al. Foods 2020;9:1679, Table 4 and Results prose (identical values)

venous_insulin_iAUC_0_120.definition: participant-positive venous insulin iAUC 0-120 min (area above pre-consumption value, no below-baseline subtraction), min*pmol/L, mean +/- SEM
venous_insulin_iAUC_0_120.n: 38 evaluable (Table 3); Figure 2 curves n=37/36/37; per-arm iAUC n not printed
venous_insulin_iAUC_0_120.paired_evidence: Repeated-measures ANOVA p<0.001 (methods describe RM ANCOVA with treatment, sequence, period); letters control a, medium b, high b; no paired ratio CI or covariance reported

venous_insulin_peak.definition: peak venous insulin, pmol/L (NOT an area; separate operator)
